summary: Taxonomic hierarchies (PBDB, Catalogue of Life), trees (Open Tree) and sequences (GenBank) are open, and character matrices with fossils exist as single-clade deposits; MorphoBank was not reachable by script. No open collection pairs living-plus-fossil character data across many clades, and fitting hierarchical versus reticulate models to them would have to be assembled.
next_step: Assemble 5-10 deposited matrices that include fossils (Dryad/Zenodo/MorphoBank via browser), and pre-register the tree-likeness measure and the simulation without extinction of intermediates.
obstacles_confirmed: A purely branching process produces nested groups even with random extinction.
Nestedness read off a classification is circular.
